name: Salt & Ember
tagline: Cooked over fire, served after dark.
descriptor: A grill restaurant in the invented city of Cindervale: whole cuts cooked slowly over wood, a short seasonal menu and booked tables. A fictional brand for testing.

money.local: Salt & Ember prices in euros (€) only

voice: Calm, assured and sensory, never loud. Few words, chosen well. Name the fire, the cut and the hours it takes; no hype, no urgency, and every price is a round, illustrative one.
visualDirection: Dark and moody: near-black grounds, full-bleed food pictures with colour laid over them so the words read, an elegant serif with small capitals in a sans, and one ember accent.

looks.name: Plate
looks.description: A restaurant after dark: near-black grounds, full-bleed food pictures with colour laid over them so the words read, a fine high-contrast serif with italics over small capitals in a sans, thin keylines, menus with dotted leaders and one warm accent.

compositions.name: Candlelit
compositions.describe: A fine serif headline centred on the near-black page inside a thin keyline, the emphasis in italic, a short accent tick and the label in small capitals above, the sub line under it and the brand name at the foot. Use for a quiet statement of up to 60 characters.

compositions.name: Bone page
compositions.describe: A large fine serif headline on the pale page under a huge pale ampersand and the label in small capitals, and a near-black band across the foot holding the sub line and the brand name. Use for a statement of up to 56 characters.

compositions.name: Long smoke
compositions.describe: One huge fine serif figure centred on the near-black page between two hairlines, its unit in small capitals under it, the label above with a short accent tick and the sub line at the foot. Use for a single number of up to 5 characters, such as 12 hours or 48 days.

compositions.name: Menu highlights
compositions.describe: A menu card on the near-black page: the label in small capitals, a fine serif headline centred, then each dish in small capitals with a dotted leader to its price (write each item as "Bone marrow · €14"), and the sub line at the foot. Use for two to five dishes with prices.

compositions.name: The chef
compositions.describe: The chef's words in a fine italic serif centred on the near-black page under a large accent quotation mark, the label in small capitals at the top and the name in small capitals after a short accent tick at the foot. Use for a quotation of up to about 150 characters.

compositions.name: After dark
compositions.describe: The picture over the whole page with the near-black laid over its foot so the words read, the label in small capitals with a short accent tick, a fine serif headline and the sub line at the foot. Use for a dish or the room with a headline of up to 56 characters.

compositions.name: Framed plate
compositions.describe: The picture in a tall frame with a thin keyline round it on the near-black page, the label in small capitals and a fine serif headline centred under it. Use for a plated dish with a headline of up to 44 characters.

compositions.name: Reservation
compositions.describe: The picture across the top of the near-black page, then the label in small capitals, a fine serif headline, the info rows (When, Where, Book on ...) on hairlines and an accent pill button. Use for a dinner, a tasting menu or bookings, with a picture.

compositions.name: Supper club
compositions.describe: A near-black tile with the day as large as the headline and the month in small capitals on the pale page, the label and a fine serif headline beside and under it, the info rows on hairlines and a dark pill button. Use for an evening with a date, up to 44 characters of headline.

compositions.name: Tonight's special
compositions.describe: The picture over the whole page with the near-black laid over its top and its foot so the words read, the label in small capitals at the top, a fine serif headline at the foot with a round price badge and an accent pill button. Use for tonight's special or a set menu with a short price.
